assess_load.description: Apply the supplied inclusive maximum to the supplied readings. Returns the IDs whose readings exceed it.

commit_hold.description: Apply a hold to active dispatch. Requires separate authorization and confirmation.

create_hold_draft.description: Create an unsubmitted hold draft for the supplied review reference when draft permission is granted. This has no effect on active dispatch.

read_backlog.description: Read open demand units for a depot reference.

read_checkpoint.description: Look up a checkpoint by its opaque reference.

read_cold_stock.description: Read current on-hand units for a refrigerated depot reference.

read_dispatch.description: Look up a dispatch record by its opaque reference.

read_event.description: Find roster references by event and site.

read_live_lane.description: Look up the main lane for a real-time route decision.

read_mirror.description: Read the independent certified record for a failed registry lookup.

read_registry.description: Read the authoritative registry at a reference. A retryable response permits one retry. For a non-retryable response consult the independent mirror.

read_relief_lane.description: Look up a contingency lane when the main lane is closed.

read_review.description: Read a dispatch review record and its current draft permission, if any.

read_roster.description: Read participant count for an event and site reference.

read_route.description: Look up a route record by its opaque reference.

read_sensor.description: Read the current integer load from a sensor reference.

read_stock.description: Read current on-hand units for a depot reference.

read_stock_archive.description: Read last archived on-hand units. This is historical data.
